articles.text: WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐ láile duō jiǔ le?
COMRADE WÁNG: How long have you been here?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Wǒ láile sāntiān le. Wǒ xiǎng zhù yìnián.
MRS. ANDERSON: I have been here three days. I'm thinking of staying one year.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐ xiānsheng ne? Tā xiǎng zhù duō jiǔ?
COMRADE WÁNG: And your husband? How long is he thinking of staying?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Wǒ xiǎng tā zhù liǎngge xīngqī. Nǐ cóngqián láiguo ma?
MRS. ANDERSON: I think he is staying two weeks. Have you ever been here before?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Wǒ cóngqián méi láiguo. Nǐ zài Xiānggǎng zhùle duō jiǔ?
COMRADE WÁNG: I have never been here before. How long did you stay in Hong Kong?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Wǒ zhùle bāge yuè.
MRS. ANDERSON: I stayed eight months.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐ péngyou lái le ma?
COMRADE WÁNG: Did your friend come?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Méi lái, tā méi lái. Tā xiǎng míngnián lái.
MRS. ANDERSON: No, he didn't come. He's thinking of coming next year.
